teaser: "Can you take the soprano section through the bridge one more time?" someone asks at choir practice, and you're the one who already knows the tempo everyone else forgot. You are a 4, the builder's path, crossed with ESFJ, the type that holds a room together by instinct. The 4 wants something built to last; the ESFJ wants everyone inside it fed, warm, accounted for. In one person, this is the one who shows up early to set out the chairs and stays late to put them away again, and forgets, in all that tending, to ask what you actually wanted to sing.
